{"summary": "Implemented re_arrange to stably interleave negative and non-negative items starting with a negative, appending any excess items in order.", "files": {"solution.py": """"Write a function to re-arrange the given array in alternating positive and negative items."""


def re_arrange(arr, n):
    """Write a function to re-arrange the given array in alternating positive and negative items.

    Negative items are placed first, followed by positive items, alternating
    thereafter. Zero is treated as a positive (non-negative) item. The
    relative order of items within the negative group and within the
    positive group is preserved. If one group has more items than the
    other, the remaining items are appended at the end in their original
    order. Only the first ``n`` items of ``arr`` are considered.

    A new list is returned; the input is not modified.
    """
    items = list(arr[:n]) if n is not None else list(arr)
    negatives = [item for item in items if item < 0]
    positives = [item for item in items if item >= 0]

    result = []
    paired = min(len(negatives), len(positives))
    for i in range(paired):
        result.append(negatives[i])
        result.append(positives[i])
    result.extend(negatives[paired:])
    result.extend(positives[paired:])
    return result
